criteria.criterion: The three new classes appear in every single-sourced consumer — txn.CLOSE_CLASSES, common.schema.json + ticket_state.schema.json, DISPOSITION_CLASSES, _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES, types.py CloseClass — with the 738a equality drift-guard updated; ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES exists in close_disposition with exact membership {duplicate, obsolete, superseded, wontfix} and a subset drift-guard test.

Non-bug tickets (task/story/epic fixture each) close with an administrative class without completion verification — reason-only classes via the new explicit precheck branch returning the disposition verdict; a non-bug close with not_a_bug/escalated (or any non-administrative class) is REFUSED in txn.transition_core naming allowed values; bug closes keep today's behavior.

obsolete/wontfix demand a reason (write-side refusal when missing, enforced in transition_core even with the completion gate off); the transition.py:549-554 "--reason only with --force" guard admits --reason WITHOUT --force for these classes; the reason threads close_ticket -> transition_core/transition_compute, persists as close_reason on the close event (distinct from force_close_reason), folds via _fold_close_metadata into reduced state, and typechecks (types.py); superseded/duplicate demand a live replacement link (_ensure_duplicate_close_is_linked widened); store-event tests per class.

A reason-only disposition close mints a SIGNED disposition attestation whose manifest carries the class+reason line; replacement-bearing closes keep the replacement line; an unsigned close for a valid disposition is RED.

The close_precheck refusal/FAIL message enumerates the applicable --class values for the ticket's type; message test asserts the 9b70 wontfix scenario is offered a truthful exit; --force on an administrative-shaped close hints the disposition alternative.
